about_the_game:
We have a discord server! (Find it on the right section of this text)

Doki Doki Theo Club is a romance visual novel in which you, the main character, whose goal is to win the heart of Theo. (the only other main character besides you) It's your first week in high school and need to get through various situations and choices in an attempt to be meaningful toward the mysterious and charming Theo.

  • CHOICES MATTER - Every time you make a choice, you're directly affecting the path your relationship with Theo is going to take. Be it being there for him through bad times, deep conversations, or even sharing personal experiences, each of your choices brings you closer or further from your ultimate goal: earning Theo's affection.

  • COMPLEX STORY - The story is full of emotional depth, from sweet, heartfelt moments to moments of tension and uncertainty as you navigate the complexities of love and connection. As you progress, you will learn more about Theo's personality, hidden layer by layer, while managing unique dynamics and unpredictable situations.

With every decision mattering, Doki Doki Theo Club is an immersive experience where your actions shape the relationship you build up with Theo. Will you successfully win his heart, or will your attempts fall short? It all depends on the choices you make throughout this game for a truly personalized and engaging gameplay.
